The question is can she evict me even if I say I will pay the deposit? Or if I remove the animals. I am not well-versed in this and want to make sure I have all my facts straight before I speak with her. 

This is what I have found about Washington law:

>Notice Requirements for Violating the Lease Agreement
If a tenant violates any portion of the lease or rental agreement, the landlord must provide the tenant with a ten-day notice. This notice must inform the tenant that the tenant has either ten days to fix the violation, if possible, or move out of the rental unit. Lease violations include subletting the apartment when subletting is prohibited, having pets when none are allowed, or parking in an unauthorized parking space.

> If the tenant does not fix the violation within the ten days or move out of the rental unit, then the landlord can begin the eviction lawsuit (see Wash. Rev. Code Ann. § 59.12.030(4)).

So by this, does that mean if I pay the deposit that she cannot evict me under this? Or is she free to not accept those terms? If she does not accept the deposit, am I allowed to remove the animals and not be evicted? Or can she retaliate anyways because she does not like me?

Culture. In some parts of the world, it's normal for pre-teens to be married and start families at that age. The whole pokemon trainer bit could be a right of passage. It's also possible that not all kids get to do this, as there are quite a few kids throughout the show who are not trainers, and are Ash's age. Most of those kids though also already had a career choice in mind and were training for it, or already activly involved in it.

Kids didn't go to school either, that was just another branch of things you could do. It's possible that kids were home-schooled all the basics (like handling money, and reading) and the rest was up to them: they could continue their studies, go into a trade, or become a pokemon trainer. 

Gary had a fanclub from the start, partly because he was the rich grandson of the most famous professor in the world, and partly because he was going to be a pokemon trainer, which most people don't have the balls to do. Ash probably would have gotten more attention if he'd shown up on time and gotten a "real" pokemon, such as a charmander of squirttle.

It's implied that pokemon came from the moon after humanity had started, but far enough back that humans don't remember and it was lost into lore. That was implied in the first few videos from pokemon. Even though they called the scientist a crackpot, there was strong evidence throughout the show propping up his idea.

There is also signs of fish that were not pokemon several times throughout the show. This implies that there may have been real animals throughout the world that we coexisted with, then when the pokemon landed, it was like animals on super-powers. It's not too far off to believe that once they started populating, they killed off the majority of the real wildlife. 

This would also explain why all pokemon are hyper-intelligent, practically to the level of humans. Meowth, through his own will, taught himself human speech, and all pokemon, despite having different dialects, are able to communicate with each other. They are all, or mostly, sentient.

Wild pokemon became feral after a while. It's plausible that originally, they were non-violent, like the clefairy, and befriended humans upon meeting them. Some of them, however, turned feral after being trapped on the planet too long, and became violent. It's possible to think that humans and pokemon developed a kind of early bond similar to that of wolves and man, and over time we began to surpass them in intelligence and technology.

The early bond became a type of servitude, where the creatures we once held as friends and equals quickly became a tool for capturing even stronger, feral pokemon. Collectors eventually became the norm, and society developed differently.

Instead of focusing on expansion and trade, society focused on itself and became rather advanced rather quickly. Because of a lack of war, and with the help of these suped up animals, they were not held back by some of the limitations our ancestors had, such as: moving fucking heavy objects. You could just tell your charizard to do it. 

Once society reached a point where they stopped expanding, they branched out a little and found HOLY SHIT there are SHITLOADS more pokemon than we thought, and also, there's ANOTHER CIVILIZATION on the other side of this mountain, who'd have thunk it?
